Deepak Gupta, J. (Oral)
1.
Claimant is seeking enhancement of compensation.
Appellant sustained injuries in motor vehicle accident which took place on 29.01.2001.
He filed a claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988, seeking compensation from driver, owner and the insurer of the two vehicles.
The Tribunal vide Award dated 07.05.2003, awarded compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- and held Respondent No.1, 2 and 3 to be jointly and severally liable to pay compensation amount along with 2.

Assailing the award it is contended by the learned counsel for the appellant that the compensation has been awarded in lump sum amount ise 2 FAO-3267-2003 (O&M) 2 of Rs.1,00,000/- without taking into consideration that the appellant had sustained 15% disability on account of malunited posterior hip fracture.

2. After arguing for some time and with the consent of counsel of the Insurance Company, it has been agreed that let the compensation amount be enhanced from Rs.1,00,000/- to Rs.1,25,000/- in lump sum.

3. Accordingly, the present petition is disposed of, by allowing the enhanced amount of 25,000/- to the appellant-claimant, payable jointly and severally by respondent No.1 to 3, along with interest @
